source: read from this repo's scripts/scripts.js + scripts/aem.js (2026-11-02)
buttonScope: p a[href] only (decorateButtons); links inside li are never buttonized
fragmentDecoration: loadFragment() runs decorateMain() + loadSections() on /nav and /footer
bodyClassFromMetadata: template metadata -> body class (decorateTemplateAndTheme); home uses Template: index

chrome.header: blocks/header renders /nav (metadata nav overrides); root .header.block carries state classes type-white | is-hover | menu-open; body.index = transparent header over the hero, every other page = white header
chrome.footer: blocks/footer renders /footer (metadata footer overrides, e.g. /footer-home on the home page)
chrome.navHeightReservation: 0px — overlay chrome (header is position: fixed); pages offset their own first section
